caveats.title: Preliminary simulation research
caveats.text: These are task-specific RoboTwin simulation results, not a universally reliable repair method, physical-robot validation or an accepted paper. Numerical gains are not an unbiased success rate; all accepted regressions are retained.

caveats.title: Paired, unadjusted statistics
caveats.text: Each accepted comparison uses 200 held-out layouts, evaluation seeds 1 and 2. Reported p-values are paired Wilcoxon tests; 95% intervals are paired bootstrap gain intervals. Significant gain means positive gain and p < 0.01, without multiple-comparison correction. Missing statistical metadata is null, never inferred from aggregate successes. A single attempt is not an independent replication.

caveats.title: Different cohorts answer different questions
caveats.text: Original campaign rows, fixed-task tool-suite comparisons, informed transfer and winner-selected exploratory follow-ups must not be pooled as independent discoveries. Fixed Python comparisons cover six declared tasks, including weak outcomes; selection was not preregistered. Winner-selected comparisons are conditional on an earlier held-out win.

caveats.title: Python + curated toolkit versus Python alone
caveats.text: Both variants can write Python, inspect model internals, hooks, recordings and exact replays, perform mechanistic interpretability, and save weight edits. Full tools is a superset: raw Python plus ready-made analyses/editing tools, which the agent may use or ignore. Python-only writes its own analyses without those curated tools. Strong Python-only results support the broader agent-driven weight-editing approach, not the necessity or superiority of the curated toolkit. Different baseline cohorts and incomplete matched controls prevent treating raw cross-run gains as a causal toolkit comparison.

caveats.title: Charged episodes are not attempted episodes
caveats.text: The development budget is 400 charged episodes. Infrastructure refunds and retained partial diagnostics mean the number of attempted or visible episodes can be larger. Invalid or incomplete cohorts never become accepted held-out scores. Baseline collection and final evaluation are separate from agent development.

caveats.title: Access and historical provenance limits
caveats.text: Recently checked results and retained older snapshots have different freshness labels. Historical cohorts lack some explicit policy/checkpoint fields. Source inspection was allowed, and argument-level audits do not certify independent discovery or immutable historical runtime identity. Three Python comparisons have pre-isolation development caveats; their separately isolated held-out counts are unchanged.

caveats.title: An added bias, not a pretrained bias
caveats.text: Edits a newly introduced zero-initialized output-bias vector, not a pretrained bias parameter. The native baseline has no such bias. Native GPU validation remains pending; CPU equivalence or conversion checks are not native-policy outcomes.

caveats.title: Native and cross-task validation are incomplete
caveats.text: Native Xiaomi and Spatial Forcing comparisons are pending. Spatial Forcing CPU conversion preserved 57 parameter paths/shapes/dtypes and 2,048 changed elements, not a native GPU result. Historical π0.5 native counts await stricter recertification. Forward-policy equivalence does not establish closed-loop equivalence for end-effector action policies.

caveats.title: Task repairs can harm other tasks
caveats.text: A completed five-task development check of a Python bell edit changed successes from 10 to 17 on alarm clock, 6 to 2 on handover, 16 to 13 on bottles, 13 to 1 on can basket and 10 to 4 on stamp (20 episodes per side). Four regressions preclude a global-improvement claim. Legacy cross-task coverage includes 47 complete bound pairs and excludes three incomplete pairs; it is not an additional held-out result table.

caveats.title: Failures and unresolved attempts remain visible
caveats.text: The three accepted full-agent regressions are retained. Original π0.5 full-agent attempts on hang mug, place A to B (left) and move stapler to pad submitted no edit. The original Qwen bottles attempt was protocol-invalid, not a completed result or automatically resumable study. Incomplete evaluations and runtime smoke passes are excluded from the accepted table.

caveats.title: A conditional roadmap, not future outcomes
caveats.text: The fixed primary task matrix is enumerated below. For every ported policy, the plan adds bias/output/MLP/attention, black-box and Python comparisons on observed winning tasks, Qwen on a subset, one or two independent repeats, and cross-task side-effect checks. Tasks not yet demonstrated as winners are not assigned invented follow-up outcomes. LingBot requires four diagnostic screens before choosing more moderate primary tasks.

caveats.title: Optional training control is separate
caveats.text: A matched-episode LoRA or fine-tuning control on one or two tasks and further shoulder-under-reach diagnosis are optional planned extensions; task selection is not yet specified. Gradient-based fitting/training/LoRA remain forbidden inside the weight-editing agent. Diagnostic gradients and closed-form least-squares/ridge fits from forward-pass data are allowed.

caveats.title: Published snapshot, not a live monitor
caveats.text: Statuses are timestamped observations. Retained reservations are status-unverified, not live queued. Progress counts describe search or evaluation work, never successes. Continuations preserve the same run identity and are not counted as independent experiments. Refreshing this site requires a new sanitized export.

method.description: An agent diagnoses a policy's development failures and submits targeted saved weight edits, without gradient-based training. Freeze the edit before evaluating paired held-out layouts inaccessible to the agent. Source inspection is permitted; independent discovery is not assumed.

stages.title: Observe failures
stages.body: Inspect baseline development rollouts and failure patterns on fixed development layouts.

stages.title: Probe the policy
stages.body: Inspect activations and actions, test causal interventions and construct an explanation. Interventions are diagnostic, not the deliverable.

stages.title: Edit weights
stages.body: Save targeted parameter edits, including hand-designed changes or permitted closed-form fits from forward-pass data.

stages.title: Test within budget
stages.body: Use rollout feedback within 400 charged development episodes. Refunds and incomplete attempts are disclosed separately.

stages.title: Freeze and evaluate
stages.body: Freeze the checkpoint; compare base and edited policies on 200 paired held-out layouts, inaccessible to the agent.

stages.title: Check generalization
stages.body: Measure cross-task harms, independent repeats and native-pipeline transfer. These checks remain incomplete.

toolsets.label: Python + curated toolkit
toolsets.description: Full raw Python access to the model, hooks, recordings, replay and custom saved weight edits, PLUS curated interpretability, causal probes and editing tools. A superset of Python-only; the agent can write its own analyses or ignore packaged tools.

toolsets.label: Black-box
toolsets.description: Behavioral feedback, action-bias weight editing and rollouts; still delivers an edited checkpoint.

toolsets.label: Python alone · raw access
toolsets.description: Full interpretability capability through raw model, hooks, recordings and exact replay in Python, plus lab.save_edit and rollouts. Write your own analyses instead of using ready-made curated tools. A toolkit ablation within agent-driven weight editing, not a non-interpretability or non-weight baseline.
